# Map electrode group target to major region
TARGET_TO_REGION = {
    'ALM': 'ALM',
    'Striatum': 'Striatum',
    'Thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Midbrain': 'Midbrain',
    'Medulla': 'Medulla',
    'BLA': 'CorticalSubplate',  # Basolateral amygdala
    'ECT': 'OtherCortex',       # Ectorhinal cortex
}


def get_unit_brain_region(anno_name, elec_target):
    """Map a unit to its major brain region using anno_name or electrode target."""
    if anno_name and anno_name != '' and str(anno_name) != 'nan':
        base = str(anno_name).split(',')[0].strip()
        if base in ANNO_TO_REGION:
            return ANNO_TO_REGION[base]
    # Fallback to electrode group target
    return elec_target


def get_electrode_target_region(location_json):
    """Extract major region from electrode location JSON."""
    d = json.loads(location_json)
    brain_regions = d['brain_regions']  # e.g., "left ALM"
    parts = brain_regions.split()
    side = parts[0]  # "left" or "right"
    region_name = ' '.join(parts[1:])  # "ALM"
    major = TARGET_TO_REGION.get(region_name, region_name)
    return side, major


def compute_firing_rates(spike_times, spike_idx, unit_indices, go_cue_time):
    """Compute firing rates for selected units in bins around go cue.

    Returns: (n_neurons, n_bins) array of firing rates.
    """
    n_neurons = len(unit_indices)
    rates = np.zeros((n_neurons, N_BINS), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, uid in enumerate(unit_indices):
        # Get spike times for this unit
        start = spike_idx[uid - 1] if uid > 0 else 0
        end = spike_idx[uid]
        st = spike_times[start:end]

        # Align to go cue
        st_aligned = st - go_cue_time

        # Count spikes in each bin
        counts, _ = np.histogram(st_aligned, bins=BIN_EDGES)
        rates[i] = counts / BIN_SIZE

    return rates


def process_session(fpath):
    """Process one NWB session file. Returns session data dict or None if filtered out."""
    with h5py.File(fpath, 'r') as f:
        # ---- Trials ----
        trials = f['intervals/trials']
        n_trials = len(trials['id'][:])

        outcomes = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                            for x in trials['outcome'][:]])
        early_licks = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                               for x in trials['early_lick'][:]])
        instructions = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                for x in trials['trial_instruction'][:]])
        auto_water = trials['auto_water'][:].astype(int)
        free_water = trials['free_water'][:].astype(int)

        photostim_onset_raw = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                        for x in trials['photostim_onset'][:]])
        photostim_dur_raw = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                      for x in trials['photostim_duration'][:]])

        # ---- Session filtering ----
        # Identify control trials (no photostim, no auto_water, no free_water)
        is_control = (photostim_onset_raw == 'N/A') & (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
        is_not_early = (early_licks == 'no early')

        # Performance = fraction correct among control, non-early-lick trials
        control_regular = is_control & is_not_early
        if np.sum(control_regular) == 0:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: no control regular trials")
            return None

        control_hits = np.sum((outcomes[control_regular] == 'hit'))
        performance = control_hits / np.sum(control_regular)

        if performance < MIN_PERFORMANCE:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: performance {performance:.2f} < {MIN_PERFORMANCE}")
            return None

        # Count correct trials per side (among control, non-early trials)
        correct_left = np.sum((outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'left') & control_regular)
        correct_right = np.sum((outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'right') & control_regular)

        if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE or correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: correct L={correct_left}, R={correct_right}")
            return None

        # ---- Trial mask: exclude auto_water and free_water ----
        trial_mask = (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
        trial_indices = np.where(trial_mask)[0]

        if len(trial_indices) < 2:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: too few valid trials")
            return None

        # ---- Go cue times ----
        go_times = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/go_start_times/timestamps'][:]

        # ---- Sample start times (tone onset) ----
        sample_starts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/sample_start_times/timestamps'][:]

        # For each trial, find the last sample_start before go cue
        # (the successful presentation that led to the delay/go sequence)
        tone_onsets = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)
        for i in range(n_trials):
            go_t = go_times[i]
            # Previous go cue as lower bound
            lower = go_times[i - 1] if i > 0 else 0.0
            mask = (sample_starts > lower) & (sample_starts < go_t)
            candidates = sample_starts[mask]
            if len(candidates) > 0:
                tone_onsets[i] = candidates[-1]  # last = successful presentation

        # ---- Photostimulation times ----
        photostim_start_times = np.array([])
        photostim_stop_times = np.array([])
        if 'photostim_start_times' in f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents']:
            ps_start_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/photostim_start_times/timestamps']
            ps_stop_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/photostim_stop_times/timestamps']
            if ps_start_ts.shape[0] > 0:
                photostim_start_times = ps_start_ts[:]
                photostim_stop_times = ps_stop_ts[:]

        # ---- Units ----
        units = f['units']
        unit_quality = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                for x in units['unit_quality'][:]])
        good_mask = (unit_quality == 'good')
        good_indices = np.where(good_mask)[0]

        if len(good_indices) == 0:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: no good units")
            return None

        # ---- Brain regions for each good unit ----
        anno_names = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                              for x in units['anno_name'][:]])
        electrodes_ref = units['electrodes'][:]

        # Build electrode group -> target region mapping
        elec_table = f['general/extracellular_ephys/electrodes']
        elec_group_names = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                    for x in elec_table['group_name'][:]])
        elec_locations = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                  for x in elec_table['location'][:]])

        # Map electrode index -> (side, major_region)
        elec_to_region = {}
        for ei in range(len(elec_group_names)):
            if ei not in elec_to_region:
                side, region = get_electrode_target_region(elec_locations[ei])
                elec_to_region[ei] = (side, region)

        # Assign brain region to each good unit
        unit_regions = []
        for uid in good_indices:
            anno = anno_names[uid]
            elec_idx = int(electrodes_ref[uid])
            side, target_region = elec_to_region.get(elec_idx, ('unknown', 'Unknown'))
            region = get_unit_brain_region(anno, target_region)
            unit_regions.append(region)

        # ---- Spike times ----
        all_spike_times = units['spike_times'][:]
        spike_times_index = units['spike_times_index'][:]

        # ---- Tongue tracking ----
        tongue_ts = None
        tongue_data = None
        if 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in f['acquisition/BehavioralTimeSeries']:
            tt = f['acquisition/BehavioralTimeSeries/Camera0_side_TongueTracking']
            tongue_ts = tt['timestamps'][:]
            tongue_data = tt['data'][:]  # (n_samples, 3): x, y, confidence

        # Compute session-wide tongue y percentiles (over visible frames)
        tongue_y_p40 = None
        tongue_y_p60 = None
        if tongue_data is not None:
            visible_mask = tongue_data[:, 2] > DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
            if np.any(visible_mask):
                visible_y = tongue_data[visible_mask, 1]
                tongue_y_p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)
                tongue_y_p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)

        # ---- Left and right lick times ----
        left_lick_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/left_lick_times/timestamps'][:]
        right_lick_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/right_lick_times/timestamps'][:]

        # ---- Process each valid trial ----
        neural_trials = []
        input_trials = []
        output_trials = []

        for trial_idx in trial_indices:
            go_t = go_times[trial_idx]

            # --- Neural: firing rates ---
            rates = compute_firing_rates(
                all_spike_times, spike_times_index, good_indices, go_t
            )
            neural_trials.append(rates)  # (n_neurons, n_bins)

            # --- Input 1: Time from tone onset (continuous, time-varying) ---
            tone_t = tone_onsets[trial_idx]
            if np.isnan(tone_t):
                # If no tone onset found, use typical value
                time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS + 1.85  # typical tone-to-go interval
            else:
                tone_rel = tone_t - go_t  # negative, tone is before go
                time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS - tone_rel  # time since tone

            # --- Input 2: Photostimulation on/off (binary, time-varying) ---
            photostim_vec = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
            if len(photostim_start_times) > 0:
                # Find photostim events for this trial
                for ps_start, ps_stop in zip(photostim_start_times, photostim_stop_times):
                    ps_start_rel = ps_start - go_t
                    ps_stop_rel = ps_stop - go_t
                    # Mark bins where photostim is on
                    for b in range(N_BINS):
                        if BIN_CENTERS[b] >= ps_start_rel and BIN_CENTERS[b] < ps_stop_rel:
                            photostim_vec[b] = 1.0

            inputs = np.stack([time_from_tone, photostim_vec], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            input_trials.append(inputs)  # (2, n_bins)

            # --- Output 1: Choice (left=0, right=1, no_lick=2) ---
            outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]
            instruction = instructions[trial_idx]
            early = early_licks[trial_idx]

            if outcome == 'ignore':
                choice = 2  # no lick
            elif outcome == 'hit':
                choice = 0 if instruction == 'left' else 1
            elif outcome == 'miss':
                # Miss = licked wrong side
                choice = 1 if instruction == 'left' else 0
            else:
                choice = 2  # fallback

            # --- Output 2: Outcome (hit=0, miss=1, ignore=2) ---
            outcome_val = {'hit': 0, 'miss': 1, 'ignore': 2}.get(outcome, 2)

            # --- Output 3: Early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---
            early_val = 0 if early == 'no early' else 1

            # --- Output 4: Tongue y-position (time-varying, discretized) ---
            tongue_y_disc = np.full(N_BINS, 3, dtype=np.int64)  # default: not visible
            if tongue_ts is not None and tongue_y_p40 is not None:
                for b in range(N_BINS):
                    t_abs = go_t + BIN_CENTERS[b]
                    # Find closest tongue frame
                    idx_closest = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, t_abs)
                    if idx_closest >= len(tongue_ts):
                        idx_closest = len(tongue_ts) - 1

                    # Check if close enough (within one frame period ~3.4ms)
                    if abs(tongue_ts[idx_closest] - t_abs) < 0.005:
                        conf = tongue_data[idx_closest, 2]
                        if conf > DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
                            y_val = tongue_data[idx_closest, 1]
                            if y_val < tongue_y_p40:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 0
                            elif y_val < tongue_y_p60:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 1
                            else:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 2

            # Combine outputs
            # Per-trial outputs: choice, outcome, early_lick
            # Time-varying output: tongue_y
            outputs = np.zeros((4, N_BINS), dtype=np.int64)
            outputs[0, :] = choice      # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[1, :] = outcome_val  # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[2, :] = early_val   # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[3, :] = tongue_y_disc  # time-varying
            output_trials.append(outputs)  # (4, n_bins)

        # ---- Subject info ----
        basename = os.path.basename(fpath)
        subject_id = basename.split('_')[0]  # e.g., "sub-440956"

        return {
            'neural': neural_trials,
            'input': input_trials,
            'output': output_trials,
            'subject_id': subject_id,
            'unit_regions': unit_regions,
            'n_good_units': len(good_indices),
            'n_trials': len(trial_indices),
            'session_name': basename,
        }


def main():
    nwb_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'sub-*', 'sub-*.nwb')))
    print(f"Found {len(nwb_files)} NWB files")

    all_sessions = []
    all_subjects = []

    for i, fpath in enumerate(nwb_files):
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(nwb_files)}] Processing {os.path.basename(fpath)}...")
        result = process_session(fpath)
        if result is not None:
            all_sessions.append(result)
            if result['subject_id'] not in all_subjects:
                all_subjects.append(result['subject_id'])
            print(f"  -> {result['n_good_units']} units, {result['n_trials']} trials")

    print(f"\n{len(all_sessions)} sessions passed filtering")
    print(f"{len(all_subjects)} subjects")

    # ---- Assemble final data structure ----
    # Collect all unique brain regions
    all_brain_regions = []
    for sess in all_sessions:
        for r in sess['unit_regions']:
            if r not in all_brain_regions:
                all_brain_regions.append(r)
    all_brain_regions = sorted(all_brain_regions)
    region_to_idx = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(all_brain_regions)}

    data = {
        'neural': [],
        'input': [],
        'output': [],
        'subjects': all_subjects,
        'subject_idx': np.zeros(len(all_sessions), dtype=np.int64),
        'brain_regions': all_brain_regions,
        'brain_region_idx': [],
        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostimulation'],
        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y_position'],
        'output_values': [
            ['left', 'right', 'no_lick'],
            ['hit', 'miss', 'ignore'],
            ['no', 'yes'],
            ['below_40pct', '40_to_60pct', 'above_60pct', 'not_visible'],
        ],
        'metadata': {
            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed response task: mice hear a tone (3kHz or 12kHz) during sample epoch, maintain memory during delay, then report by licking left or right after go cue',
            'time_bin_size': BIN_SIZE * 1000,  # in ms
            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',
            'off_start': -TIME_BEFORE,
            'off_end': TIME_AFTER,
            'bin_centers': BIN_CENTERS.tolist(),
            'dataset': 'MAP (Mesoscale Activity Project)',
            'paper': 'Brain-wide neural activity underlying memory-guided movement',
            'n_sessions': len(all_sessions),
            'n_subjects': len(all_subjects),
        }
    }

    for i, sess in enumerate(all_sessions):
        data['neural'].append(sess['neural'])
        data['input'].append(sess['input'])
        data['output'].append(sess['output'])
        data['subject_idx'][i] = all_subjects.index(sess['subject_id'])
        data['brain_region_idx'].append(
            np.array([region_to_idx[r] for r in sess['unit_regions']], dtype=np.int64)
        )

    # ---- Save ----
    print(f"\nSaving to {OUTPUT_FILE}...")
    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(data, f)

    # Print summary
    total_neurons = sum(len(s['unit_regions']) for s in all_sessions)
    total_trials = sum(s['n_trials'] for s in all_sessions)
    print(f"Total sessions: {len(all_sessions)}")
    print(f"Total neurons: {total_neurons}")
    print(f"Total trials: {total_trials}")
    print(f"Brain regions: {all_brain_regions}")
    print("Done!")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""
Convert NWB data from the MAP (Mesoscale Activity Project) dataset into the
standardized decoder format.

Data source: "Brain-wide neural activity underlying memory-guided movement"
Processing follows: "Brain-wide analysis reveals movement encoding structured
across and within brain areas"

Key decisions:
- Neuron filtering: Only "good" units (classifier-based QC per the data paper)
- Session filtering: >65% correct on control trials, >=50 correct lick-left
  and >=50 correct lick-right trials (per the data paper methods)
- Trial filtering: Exclude auto_water and free_water trials (not real behavioral
  trials). Keep early lick and no-response (ignore) trials since early_lick and
  outcome are decoder outputs.
- Brain region: Use anno_name (CCF annotation) mapped to major categories;
  fall back to electrode group target region for units without annotation.
- Temporal alignment: Go cue onset, [-2.5, 1.5] s, 50 ms bins (80 bins)
- Firing rates: spike counts per bin / bin_width
- Tone onset: last sample_start before each trial's go cue (the successful
  presentation, not earlier replays from early licking)
- Photostimulation: binary time series, 1 during photostim on period
- Tongue y-position: discretized per session using DLC confidence > 0.9 for
  visibility, percentiles over visible positions in the entire session
"""

import os
import glob
import json
import pickle
import numpy as np
import h5py
from collections import OrderedDict

# ---- Parameters ----
TIME_BEFORE = 2.5    # seconds before go cue
TIME_AFTER = 1.5     # seconds after go cue
BIN_SIZE = 0.05      # 50 ms bins
N_BINS = int((TIME_BEFORE + TIME_AFTER) / BIN_SIZE)  # 80
BIN_EDGES = np.linspace(-TIME_BEFORE, TIME_AFTER, N_BINS + 1)
BIN_CENTERS = (BIN_EDGES[:-1] + BIN_EDGES[1:]) / 2

MIN_PERFORMANCE = 0.65
MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE = 50

DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.9

DATA_DIR = '/app/data'
OUTPUT_FILE = '/app/converted_data.pkl'

# ---- Brain region mapping ----
# Maps anno_name base (before comma) to major region categories
# following the reference code's 14 regions
ANNO_TO_REGION = {
    # ALM = anterior lateral motor cortex = secondary motor area
    'Secondary motor area': 'ALM',
    # Other cortex
    'Primary motor area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Primary somatosensory area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Primary visual area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Agranular insular area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Anterior cingulate area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Retrosplenial area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Prelimbic area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Dorsal peduncular area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Frontal pole': 'OtherCortex',
    'Infralimbic area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Supplemental somatosensory area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Visceral area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Gustatory areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Temporal association areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Perirhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Ectorhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Entorhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Posterior parietal association areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Postsubiculum': 'OtherCortex',
    # Orbital
    'Orbital area': 'Orbital',
    # Striatum
    'Caudoputamen': 'Striatum',
    'Striatum': 'Striatum',
    'Nucleus accumbens': 'Striatum',
    'Fundus of striatum': 'Striatum',
    # Pallidum
    'Pallidum': 'Pallidum',
    'Globus pallidus': 'Pallidum',
    'Substantia innominata': 'Pallidum',
    'Bed nuclei of the stria terminalis': 'Pallidum',
    # Thalamus
    'Thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anteromedial nucleus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anteroventral nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Central lateral nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Lateral dorsal nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Lateral posterior nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Mediodorsal nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Paracentral nucleus': 'Thalamus',
    'Posterior complex of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Reticular nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Submedial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral anterior-lateral complex of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral medial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral posterolateral nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral posteromedial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anterodorsal nucleus': 'Thalamus',

# Map electrode group target to major region
TARGET_TO_REGION = {
    'ALM': 'ALM',
    'Striatum': 'Striatum',
    'Thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Midbrain': 'Midbrain',
    'Medulla': 'Medulla',
    'BLA': 'CorticalSubplate',  # Basolateral amygdala
    'ECT': 'OtherCortex',       # Ectorhinal cortex
}


def get_unit_brain_region(anno_name, elec_target):
    """Map a unit to its major brain region using anno_name or electrode target."""
    if anno_name and anno_name != '' and str(anno_name) != 'nan':
        base = str(anno_name).split(',')[0].strip()
        if base in ANNO_TO_REGION:
            return ANNO_TO_REGION[base]
    # Fallback to electrode group target
    return elec_target


def get_electrode_target_region(location_json):
    """Extract major region from electrode location JSON."""
    d = json.loads(location_json)
    brain_regions = d['brain_regions']  # e.g., "left ALM"
    parts = brain_regions.split()
    side = parts[0]  # "left" or "right"
    region_name = ' '.join(parts[1:])  # "ALM"
    major = TARGET_TO_REGION.get(region_name, region_name)
    return side, major


def compute_firing_rates(spike_times, spike_idx, unit_indices, go_cue_time):
    """Compute firing rates for selected units in bins around go cue.

    Returns: (n_neurons, n_bins) array of firing rates.
    """
    n_neurons = len(unit_indices)
    rates = np.zeros((n_neurons, N_BINS), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, uid in enumerate(unit_indices):
        # Get spike times for this unit
        start = spike_idx[uid - 1] if uid > 0 else 0
        end = spike_idx[uid]
        st = spike_times[start:end]

        # Align to go cue
        st_aligned = st - go_cue_time

        # Count spikes in each bin
        counts, _ = np.histogram(st_aligned, bins=BIN_EDGES)
        rates[i] = counts / BIN_SIZE

    return rates


def process_session(fpath):
    """Process one NWB session file. Returns session data dict or None if filtered out."""
    with h5py.File(fpath, 'r') as f:
        # ---- Trials ----
        trials = f['intervals/trials']
        n_trials = len(trials['id'][:])

        outcomes = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                            for x in trials['outcome'][:]])
        early_licks = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                               for x in trials['early_lick'][:]])
        instructions = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                for x in trials['trial_instruction'][:]])
        auto_water = trials['auto_water'][:].astype(int)
        free_water = trials['free_water'][:].astype(int)

        photostim_onset_raw = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                        for x in trials['photostim_onset'][:]])
        photostim_dur_raw = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                      for x in trials['photostim_duration'][:]])

        # ---- Session filtering ----
        # Identify control trials (no photostim, no auto_water, no free_water)
        is_control = (photostim_onset_raw == 'N/A') & (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
        is_not_early = (early_licks == 'no early')

        # Performance = fraction correct among control, non-early-lick trials
        control_regular = is_control & is_not_early
        if np.sum(control_regular) == 0:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: no control regular trials")
            return None

        control_hits = np.sum((outcomes[control_regular] == 'hit'))
        performance = control_hits / np.sum(control_regular)

        if performance < MIN_PERFORMANCE:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: performance {performance:.2f} < {MIN_PERFORMANCE}")
            return None

        # Count correct trials per side (among control, non-early trials)
        correct_left = np.sum((outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'left') & control_regular)
        correct_right = np.sum((outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'right') & control_regular)

        if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE or correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: correct L={correct_left}, R={correct_right}")
            return None

        # ---- Trial mask: exclude auto_water and free_water ----
        trial_mask = (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
        trial_indices = np.where(trial_mask)[0]

        if len(trial_indices) < 2:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: too few valid trials")
            return None

        # ---- Go cue times ----
        go_times = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/go_start_times/timestamps'][:]

        # ---- Sample start times (tone onset) ----
        sample_starts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/sample_start_times/timestamps'][:]

        # For each trial, find the last sample_start before go cue
        # (the successful presentation that led to the delay/go sequence)
        tone_onsets = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)
        for i in range(n_trials):
            go_t = go_times[i]
            # Previous go cue as lower bound
            lower = go_times[i - 1] if i > 0 else 0.0
            mask = (sample_starts > lower) & (sample_starts < go_t)
            candidates = sample_starts[mask]
            if len(candidates) > 0:
                tone_onsets[i] = candidates[-1]  # last = successful presentation

        # ---- Photostimulation times ----
        photostim_start_times = np.array([])
        photostim_stop_times = np.array([])
        if 'photostim_start_times' in f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents']:
            ps_start_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/photostim_start_times/timestamps']
            ps_stop_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/photostim_stop_times/timestamps']
            if ps_start_ts.shape[0] > 0:
                photostim_start_times = ps_start_ts[:]
                photostim_stop_times = ps_stop_ts[:]

        # ---- Units ----
        units = f['units']
        unit_quality = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                for x in units['unit_quality'][:]])
        good_mask = (unit_quality == 'good')
        good_indices = np.where(good_mask)[0]

        if len(good_indices) == 0:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: no good units")
            return None

        # ---- Brain regions for each good unit ----
        anno_names = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                              for x in units['anno_name'][:]])
        electrodes_ref = units['electrodes'][:]

        # Build electrode group -> target region mapping
        elec_table = f['general/extracellular_ephys/electrodes']
        elec_group_names = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                    for x in elec_table['group_name'][:]])
        elec_locations = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                  for x in elec_table['location'][:]])

        # Map electrode index -> (side, major_region)
        elec_to_region = {}
        for ei in range(len(elec_group_names)):
            if ei not in elec_to_region:
                side, region = get_electrode_target_region(elec_locations[ei])
                elec_to_region[ei] = (side, region)

        # Assign brain region to each good unit
        unit_regions = []
        for uid in good_indices:
            anno = anno_names[uid]
            elec_idx = int(electrodes_ref[uid])
            side, target_region = elec_to_region.get(elec_idx, ('unknown', 'Unknown'))
            region = get_unit_brain_region(anno, target_region)
            unit_regions.append(region)

        # ---- Spike times ----
        all_spike_times = units['spike_times'][:]
        spike_times_index = units['spike_times_index'][:]

        # ---- Tongue tracking ----
        tongue_ts = None
        tongue_data = None
        if 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in f['acquisition/BehavioralTimeSeries']:
            tt = f['acquisition/BehavioralTimeSeries/Camera0_side_TongueTracking']
            tongue_ts = tt['timestamps'][:]
            tongue_data = tt['data'][:]  # (n_samples, 3): x, y, confidence

        # Compute session-wide tongue y percentiles (over visible frames)
        tongue_y_p40 = None
        tongue_y_p60 = None
        if tongue_data is not None:
            visible_mask = tongue_data[:, 2] > DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
            if np.any(visible_mask):
                visible_y = tongue_data[visible_mask, 1]
                tongue_y_p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)
                tongue_y_p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)

        # ---- Left and right lick times ----
        left_lick_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/left_lick_times/timestamps'][:]
        right_lick_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/right_lick_times/timestamps'][:]

        # ---- Process each valid trial ----
        neural_trials = []
        input_trials = []
        output_trials = []

        for trial_idx in trial_indices:
            go_t = go_times[trial_idx]

            # --- Neural: firing rates ---
            rates = compute_firing_rates(
                all_spike_times, spike_times_index, good_indices, go_t
            )
            neural_trials.append(rates)  # (n_neurons, n_bins)

            # --- Input 1: Time from tone onset (continuous, time-varying) ---
            tone_t = tone_onsets[trial_idx]
            if np.isnan(tone_t):
                # If no tone onset found, use typical value
                time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS + 1.85  # typical tone-to-go interval
            else:
                tone_rel = tone_t - go_t  # negative, tone is before go
                time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS - tone_rel  # time since tone

            # --- Input 2: Photostimulation on/off (binary, time-varying) ---
            photostim_vec = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
            if len(photostim_start_times) > 0:
                # Find photostim events for this trial
                for ps_start, ps_stop in zip(photostim_start_times, photostim_stop_times):
                    ps_start_rel = ps_start - go_t
                    ps_stop_rel = ps_stop - go_t
                    # Mark bins where photostim is on
                    for b in range(N_BINS):
                        if BIN_CENTERS[b] >= ps_start_rel and BIN_CENTERS[b] < ps_stop_rel:
                            photostim_vec[b] = 1.0

            inputs = np.stack([time_from_tone, photostim_vec], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            input_trials.append(inputs)  # (2, n_bins)

            # --- Output 1: Choice (left=0, right=1, no_lick=2) ---
            outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]
            instruction = instructions[trial_idx]
            early = early_licks[trial_idx]

            if outcome == 'ignore':
                choice = 2  # no lick
            elif outcome == 'hit':
                choice = 0 if instruction == 'left' else 1
            elif outcome == 'miss':
                # Miss = licked wrong side
                choice = 1 if instruction == 'left' else 0
            else:
                choice = 2  # fallback

            # --- Output 2: Outcome (hit=0, miss=1, ignore=2) ---
            outcome_val = {'hit': 0, 'miss': 1, 'ignore': 2}.get(outcome, 2)

            # --- Output 3: Early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---
            early_val = 0 if early == 'no early' else 1

            # --- Output 4: Tongue y-position (time-varying, discretized) ---
            tongue_y_disc = np.full(N_BINS, 3, dtype=np.int64)  # default: not visible
            if tongue_ts is not None and tongue_y_p40 is not None:
                for b in range(N_BINS):
                    t_abs = go_t + BIN_CENTERS[b]
                    # Find closest tongue frame
                    idx_closest = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, t_abs)
                    if idx_closest >= len(tongue_ts):
                        idx_closest = len(tongue_ts) - 1

                    # Check if close enough (within one frame period ~3.4ms)
                    if abs(tongue_ts[idx_closest] - t_abs) < 0.005:
                        conf = tongue_data[idx_closest, 2]
                        if conf > DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
                            y_val = tongue_data[idx_closest, 1]
                            if y_val < tongue_y_p40:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 0
                            elif y_val < tongue_y_p60:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 1
                            else:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 2

            # Combine outputs
            # Per-trial outputs: choice, outcome, early_lick
            # Time-varying output: tongue_y
            outputs = np.zeros((4, N_BINS), dtype=np.int64)
            outputs[0, :] = choice      # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[1, :] = outcome_val  # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[2, :] = early_val   # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[3, :] = tongue_y_disc  # time-varying
            output_trials.append(outputs)  # (4, n_bins)

        # ---- Subject info ----
        basename = os.path.basename(fpath)
        subject_id = basename.split('_')[0]  # e.g., "sub-440956"

        return {
            'neural': neural_trials,
            'input': input_trials,
            'output': output_trials,
            'subject_id': subject_id,
            'unit_regions': unit_regions,
            'n_good_units': len(good_indices),
            'n_trials': len(trial_indices),
            'session_name': basename,
        }


def main():
    nwb_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'sub-*', 'sub-*.nwb')))
    print(f"Found {len(nwb_files)} NWB files")

    all_sessions = []
    all_subjects = []

    for i, fpath in enumerate(nwb_files):
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(nwb_files)}] Processing {os.path.basename(fpath)}...")
        result = process_session(fpath)
        if result is not None:
            all_sessions.append(result)
            if result['subject_id'] not in all_subjects:
                all_subjects.append(result['subject_id'])
            print(f"  -> {result['n_good_units']} units, {result['n_trials']} trials")

    print(f"\n{len(all_sessions)} sessions passed filtering")
    print(f"{len(all_subjects)} subjects")

    # ---- Assemble final data structure ----
    # Collect all unique brain regions
    all_brain_regions = []
    for sess in all_sessions:
        for r in sess['unit_regions']:
            if r not in all_brain_regions:
                all_brain_regions.append(r)
    all_brain_regions = sorted(all_brain_regions)
    region_to_idx = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(all_brain_regions)}

    data = {
        'neural': [],
        'input': [],
        'output': [],
        'subjects': all_subjects,
        'subject_idx': np.zeros(len(all_sessions), dtype=np.int64),
        'brain_regions': all_brain_regions,
        'brain_region_idx': [],
        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostimulation'],
        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y_position'],
        'output_values': [
            ['left', 'right', 'no_lick'],
            ['hit', 'miss', 'ignore'],
            ['no', 'yes'],
            ['below_40pct', '40_to_60pct', 'above_60pct', 'not_visible'],
        ],
        'metadata': {
            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed response task: mice hear a tone (3kHz or 12kHz) during sample epoch, maintain memory during delay, then report by licking left or right after go cue',
            'time_bin_size': BIN_SIZE * 1000,  # in ms
            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',
            'off_start': -TIME_BEFORE,
            'off_end': TIME_AFTER,
            'bin_centers': BIN_CENTERS.tolist(),
            'dataset': 'MAP (Mesoscale Activity Project)',
            'paper': 'Brain-wide neural activity underlying memory-guided movement',
            'n_sessions': len(all_sessions),
            'n_subjects': len(all_subjects),
        }
    }

    for i, sess in enumerate(all_sessions):
        data['neural'].append(sess['neural'])
        data['input'].append(sess['input'])
        data['output'].append(sess['output'])
        data['subject_idx'][i] = all_subjects.index(sess['subject_id'])
        data['brain_region_idx'].append(
            np.array([region_to_idx[r] for r in sess['unit_regions']], dtype=np.int64)
        )

    # ---- Save ----
    print(f"\nSaving to {OUTPUT_FILE}...")
    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(data, f)

    # Print summary
    total_neurons = sum(len(s['unit_regions']) for s in all_sessions)
    total_trials = sum(s['n_trials'] for s in all_sessions)
    print(f"Total sessions: {len(all_sessions)}")
    print(f"Total neurons: {total_neurons}")
    print(f"Total trials: {total_trials}")
    print(f"Brain regions: {all_brain_regions}")
    print("Done!")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""
Convert NWB data from the MAP (Mesoscale Activity Project) dataset into the
standardized decoder format.

Data source: "Brain-wide neural activity underlying memory-guided movement"
Processing follows: "Brain-wide analysis reveals movement encoding structured
across and within brain areas"

Key decisions:
- Neuron filtering: Only "good" units (classifier-based QC per the data paper)
- Session filtering: >65% correct on control trials, >=50 correct lick-left
  and >=50 correct lick-right trials (per the data paper methods)
- Trial filtering: Exclude auto_water and free_water trials (not real behavioral
  trials). Keep early lick and no-response (ignore) trials since early_lick and
  outcome are decoder outputs.
- Brain region: Use anno_name (CCF annotation) mapped to major categories;
  fall back to electrode group target region for units without annotation.
- Temporal alignment: Go cue onset, [-2.5, 1.5] s, 50 ms bins (80 bins)
- Firing rates: spike counts per bin / bin_width
- Tone onset: last sample_start before each trial's go cue (the successful
  presentation, not earlier replays from early licking)
- Photostimulation: binary time series, 1 during photostim on period
- Tongue y-position: discretized per session using DLC confidence > 0.9 for
  visibility, percentiles over visible positions in the entire session
"""

import os
import glob
import json
import pickle
import numpy as np
import h5py
from collections import OrderedDict

# ---- Parameters ----
TIME_BEFORE = 2.5    # seconds before go cue
TIME_AFTER = 1.5     # seconds after go cue
BIN_SIZE = 0.05      # 50 ms bins
N_BINS = int((TIME_BEFORE + TIME_AFTER) / BIN_SIZE)  # 80
BIN_EDGES = np.linspace(-TIME_BEFORE, TIME_AFTER, N_BINS + 1)
BIN_CENTERS = (BIN_EDGES[:-1] + BIN_EDGES[1:]) / 2

MIN_PERFORMANCE = 0.65
MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE = 50

DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.9

DATA_DIR = '/app/data'
OUTPUT_FILE = '/app/converted_data.pkl'

# ---- Brain region mapping ----
# Maps anno_name base (before comma) to major region categories
# following the reference code's 14 regions
ANNO_TO_REGION = {
    # ALM = anterior lateral motor cortex = secondary motor area
    'Secondary motor area': 'ALM',
    # Other cortex
    'Primary motor area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Primary somatosensory area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Primary visual area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Agranular insular area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Anterior cingulate area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Retrosplenial area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Prelimbic area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Dorsal peduncular area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Frontal pole': 'OtherCortex',
    'Infralimbic area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Supplemental somatosensory area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Visceral area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Gustatory areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Temporal association areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Perirhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Ectorhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Entorhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Posterior parietal association areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Postsubiculum': 'OtherCortex',
    # Orbital
    'Orbital area': 'Orbital',
    # Striatum
    'Caudoputamen': 'Striatum',
    'Striatum': 'Striatum',
    'Nucleus accumbens': 'Striatum',
    'Fundus of striatum': 'Striatum',
    # Pallidum
    'Pallidum': 'Pallidum',
    'Globus pallidus': 'Pallidum',
    'Substantia innominata': 'Pallidum',
    'Bed nuclei of the stria terminalis': 'Pallidum',
    # Thalamus
    'Thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anteromedial nucleus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anteroventral nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Central lateral nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Lateral dorsal nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Lateral posterior nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Mediodorsal nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Paracentral nucleus': 'Thalamus',
    'Posterior complex of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Reticular nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Submedial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral anterior-lateral complex of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral medial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral posterolateral nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral posteromedial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anterodorsal nucleus': 'Thalamus',

# Map electrode group target to major region
TARGET_TO_REGION = {
    'ALM': 'ALM',
    'Striatum': 'Striatum',
    'Thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Midbrain': 'Midbrain',
    'Medulla': 'Medulla',
    'BLA': 'CorticalSubplate',  # Basolateral amygdala
    'ECT': 'OtherCortex',       # Ectorhinal cortex
}


def get_unit_brain_region(anno_name, elec_target):
    """Map a unit to its major brain region using anno_name or electrode target."""
    if anno_name and anno_name != '' and str(anno_name) != 'nan':
        base = str(anno_name).split(',')[0].strip()
        if base in ANNO_TO_REGION:
            return ANNO_TO_REGION[base]
    # Fallback to electrode group target
    return elec_target


def get_electrode_target_region(location_json):
    """Extract major region from electrode location JSON."""
    d = json.loads(location_json)
    brain_regions = d['brain_regions']  # e.g., "left ALM"
    parts = brain_regions.split()
    side = parts[0]  # "left" or "right"
    region_name = ' '.join(parts[1:])  # "ALM"
    major = TARGET_TO_REGION.get(region_name, region_name)
    return side, major


def compute_firing_rates(spike_times, spike_idx, unit_indices, go_cue_time):
    """Compute firing rates for selected units in bins around go cue.

    Returns: (n_neurons, n_bins) array of firing rates.
    """
    n_neurons = len(unit_indices)
    rates = np.zeros((n_neurons, N_BINS), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, uid in enumerate(unit_indices):
        # Get spike times for this unit
        start = spike_idx[uid - 1] if uid > 0 else 0
        end = spike_idx[uid]
        st = spike_times[start:end]

        # Align to go cue
        st_aligned = st - go_cue_time

        # Count spikes in each bin
        counts, _ = np.histogram(st_aligned, bins=BIN_EDGES)
        rates[i] = counts / BIN_SIZE

    return rates


def process_session(fpath):
    """Process one NWB session file. Returns session data dict or None if filtered out."""
    with h5py.File(fpath, 'r') as f:
        # ---- Trials ----
        trials = f['intervals/trials']
        n_trials = len(trials['id'][:])

        outcomes = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                            for x in trials['outcome'][:]])
        early_licks = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                               for x in trials['early_lick'][:]])
        instructions = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                for x in trials['trial_instruction'][:]])
        auto_water = trials['auto_water'][:].astype(int)
        free_water = trials['free_water'][:].astype(int)

        photostim_onset_raw = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                        for x in trials['photostim_onset'][:]])
        photostim_dur_raw = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                      for x in trials['photostim_duration'][:]])

        # ---- Session filtering ----
        # Identify control trials (no photostim, no auto_water, no free_water)
        is_control = (photostim_onset_raw == 'N/A') & (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
        is_not_early = (early_licks == 'no early')

        # Performance = fraction correct among control, non-early-lick trials
        control_regular = is_control & is_not_early
        if np.sum(control_regular) == 0:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: no control regular trials")
            return None

        control_hits = np.sum((outcomes[control_regular] == 'hit'))
        performance = control_hits / np.sum(control_regular)

        if performance < MIN_PERFORMANCE:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: performance {performance:.2f} < {MIN_PERFORMANCE}")
            return None

        # Count correct trials per side (among control, non-early trials)
        correct_left = np.sum((outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'left') & control_regular)
        correct_right = np.sum((outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'right') & control_regular)

        if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE or correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: correct L={correct_left}, R={correct_right}")
            return None

        # ---- Trial mask: exclude auto_water and free_water ----
        trial_mask = (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
        trial_indices = np.where(trial_mask)[0]

        if len(trial_indices) < 2:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: too few valid trials")
            return None

        # ---- Go cue times ----
        go_times = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/go_start_times/timestamps'][:]

        # ---- Sample start times (tone onset) ----
        sample_starts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/sample_start_times/timestamps'][:]

        # For each trial, find the last sample_start before go cue
        # (the successful presentation that led to the delay/go sequence)
        tone_onsets = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)
        for i in range(n_trials):
            go_t = go_times[i]
            # Previous go cue as lower bound
            lower = go_times[i - 1] if i > 0 else 0.0
            mask = (sample_starts > lower) & (sample_starts < go_t)
            candidates = sample_starts[mask]
            if len(candidates) > 0:
                tone_onsets[i] = candidates[-1]  # last = successful presentation

        # ---- Photostimulation times ----
        photostim_start_times = np.array([])
        photostim_stop_times = np.array([])
        if 'photostim_start_times' in f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents']:
            ps_start_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/photostim_start_times/timestamps']
            ps_stop_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/photostim_stop_times/timestamps']
            if ps_start_ts.shape[0] > 0:
                photostim_start_times = ps_start_ts[:]
                photostim_stop_times = ps_stop_ts[:]

        # ---- Units ----
        units = f['units']
        unit_quality = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                for x in units['unit_quality'][:]])
        good_mask = (unit_quality == 'good')
        good_indices = np.where(good_mask)[0]

        if len(good_indices) == 0:
            print(f"  Skipping {os.path.basename(fpath)}: no good units")
            return None

        # ---- Brain regions for each good unit ----
        anno_names = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                              for x in units['anno_name'][:]])
        electrodes_ref = units['electrodes'][:]

        # Build electrode group -> target region mapping
        elec_table = f['general/extracellular_ephys/electrodes']
        elec_group_names = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                    for x in elec_table['group_name'][:]])
        elec_locations = np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else str(x)
                                  for x in elec_table['location'][:]])

        # Map electrode index -> (side, major_region)
        elec_to_region = {}
        for ei in range(len(elec_group_names)):
            if ei not in elec_to_region:
                side, region = get_electrode_target_region(elec_locations[ei])
                elec_to_region[ei] = (side, region)

        # Assign brain region to each good unit
        unit_regions = []
        for uid in good_indices:
            anno = anno_names[uid]
            elec_idx = int(electrodes_ref[uid])
            side, target_region = elec_to_region.get(elec_idx, ('unknown', 'Unknown'))
            region = get_unit_brain_region(anno, target_region)
            unit_regions.append(region)

        # ---- Spike times ----
        all_spike_times = units['spike_times'][:]
        spike_times_index = units['spike_times_index'][:]

        # ---- Tongue tracking ----
        tongue_ts = None
        tongue_data = None
        if 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in f['acquisition/BehavioralTimeSeries']:
            tt = f['acquisition/BehavioralTimeSeries/Camera0_side_TongueTracking']
            tongue_ts = tt['timestamps'][:]
            tongue_data = tt['data'][:]  # (n_samples, 3): x, y, confidence

        # Compute session-wide tongue y percentiles (over visible frames)
        tongue_y_p40 = None
        tongue_y_p60 = None
        if tongue_data is not None:
            visible_mask = tongue_data[:, 2] > DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
            if np.any(visible_mask):
                visible_y = tongue_data[visible_mask, 1]
                tongue_y_p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)
                tongue_y_p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)

        # ---- Left and right lick times ----
        left_lick_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/left_lick_times/timestamps'][:]
        right_lick_ts = f['acquisition/BehavioralEvents/right_lick_times/timestamps'][:]

        # ---- Process each valid trial ----
        neural_trials = []
        input_trials = []
        output_trials = []

        for trial_idx in trial_indices:
            go_t = go_times[trial_idx]

            # --- Neural: firing rates ---
            rates = compute_firing_rates(
                all_spike_times, spike_times_index, good_indices, go_t
            )
            neural_trials.append(rates)  # (n_neurons, n_bins)

            # --- Input 1: Time from tone onset (continuous, time-varying) ---
            tone_t = tone_onsets[trial_idx]
            if np.isnan(tone_t):
                # If no tone onset found, use typical value
                time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS + 1.85  # typical tone-to-go interval
            else:
                tone_rel = tone_t - go_t  # negative, tone is before go
                time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS - tone_rel  # time since tone

            # --- Input 2: Photostimulation on/off (binary, time-varying) ---
            photostim_vec = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
            if len(photostim_start_times) > 0:
                # Find photostim events for this trial
                for ps_start, ps_stop in zip(photostim_start_times, photostim_stop_times):
                    ps_start_rel = ps_start - go_t
                    ps_stop_rel = ps_stop - go_t
                    # Mark bins where photostim is on
                    for b in range(N_BINS):
                        if BIN_CENTERS[b] >= ps_start_rel and BIN_CENTERS[b] < ps_stop_rel:
                            photostim_vec[b] = 1.0

            inputs = np.stack([time_from_tone, photostim_vec], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
            input_trials.append(inputs)  # (2, n_bins)

            # --- Output 1: Choice (left=0, right=1, no_lick=2) ---
            outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]
            instruction = instructions[trial_idx]
            early = early_licks[trial_idx]

            if outcome == 'ignore':
                choice = 2  # no lick
            elif outcome == 'hit':
                choice = 0 if instruction == 'left' else 1
            elif outcome == 'miss':
                # Miss = licked wrong side
                choice = 1 if instruction == 'left' else 0
            else:
                choice = 2  # fallback

            # --- Output 2: Outcome (hit=0, miss=1, ignore=2) ---
            outcome_val = {'hit': 0, 'miss': 1, 'ignore': 2}.get(outcome, 2)

            # --- Output 3: Early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---
            early_val = 0 if early == 'no early' else 1

            # --- Output 4: Tongue y-position (time-varying, discretized) ---
            tongue_y_disc = np.full(N_BINS, 3, dtype=np.int64)  # default: not visible
            if tongue_ts is not None and tongue_y_p40 is not None:
                for b in range(N_BINS):
                    t_abs = go_t + BIN_CENTERS[b]
                    # Find closest tongue frame
                    idx_closest = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, t_abs)
                    if idx_closest >= len(tongue_ts):
                        idx_closest = len(tongue_ts) - 1

                    # Check if close enough (within one frame period ~3.4ms)
                    if abs(tongue_ts[idx_closest] - t_abs) < 0.005:
                        conf = tongue_data[idx_closest, 2]
                        if conf > DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
                            y_val = tongue_data[idx_closest, 1]
                            if y_val < tongue_y_p40:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 0
                            elif y_val < tongue_y_p60:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 1
                            else:
                                tongue_y_disc[b] = 2

            # Combine outputs
            # Per-trial outputs: choice, outcome, early_lick
            # Time-varying output: tongue_y
            outputs = np.zeros((4, N_BINS), dtype=np.int64)
            outputs[0, :] = choice      # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[1, :] = outcome_val  # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[2, :] = early_val   # per-trial, broadcast
            outputs[3, :] = tongue_y_disc  # time-varying
            output_trials.append(outputs)  # (4, n_bins)

        # ---- Subject info ----
        basename = os.path.basename(fpath)
        subject_id = basename.split('_')[0]  # e.g., "sub-440956"

        return {
            'neural': neural_trials,
            'input': input_trials,
            'output': output_trials,
            'subject_id': subject_id,
            'unit_regions': unit_regions,
            'n_good_units': len(good_indices),
            'n_trials': len(trial_indices),
            'session_name': basename,
        }


def main():
    nwb_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'sub-*', 'sub-*.nwb')))
    print(f"Found {len(nwb_files)} NWB files")

    all_sessions = []
    all_subjects = []

    for i, fpath in enumerate(nwb_files):
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(nwb_files)}] Processing {os.path.basename(fpath)}...")
        result = process_session(fpath)
        if result is not None:
            all_sessions.append(result)
            if result['subject_id'] not in all_subjects:
                all_subjects.append(result['subject_id'])
            print(f"  -> {result['n_good_units']} units, {result['n_trials']} trials")

    print(f"\n{len(all_sessions)} sessions passed filtering")
    print(f"{len(all_subjects)} subjects")

    # ---- Assemble final data structure ----
    # Collect all unique brain regions
    all_brain_regions = []
    for sess in all_sessions:
        for r in sess['unit_regions']:
            if r not in all_brain_regions:
                all_brain_regions.append(r)
    all_brain_regions = sorted(all_brain_regions)
    region_to_idx = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(all_brain_regions)}

    data = {
        'neural': [],
        'input': [],
        'output': [],
        'subjects': all_subjects,
        'subject_idx': np.zeros(len(all_sessions), dtype=np.int64),
        'brain_regions': all_brain_regions,
        'brain_region_idx': [],
        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostimulation'],
        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y_position'],
        'output_values': [
            ['left', 'right', 'no_lick'],
            ['hit', 'miss', 'ignore'],
            ['no', 'yes'],
            ['below_40pct', '40_to_60pct', 'above_60pct', 'not_visible'],
        ],
        'metadata': {
            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed response task: mice hear a tone (3kHz or 12kHz) during sample epoch, maintain memory during delay, then report by licking left or right after go cue',
            'time_bin_size': BIN_SIZE * 1000,  # in ms
            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',
            'off_start': -TIME_BEFORE,
            'off_end': TIME_AFTER,
            'bin_centers': BIN_CENTERS.tolist(),
            'dataset': 'MAP (Mesoscale Activity Project)',
            'paper': 'Brain-wide neural activity underlying memory-guided movement',
            'n_sessions': len(all_sessions),
            'n_subjects': len(all_subjects),
        }
    }

    for i, sess in enumerate(all_sessions):
        data['neural'].append(sess['neural'])
        data['input'].append(sess['input'])
        data['output'].append(sess['output'])
        data['subject_idx'][i] = all_subjects.index(sess['subject_id'])
        data['brain_region_idx'].append(
            np.array([region_to_idx[r] for r in sess['unit_regions']], dtype=np.int64)
        )

    # ---- Save ----
    print(f"\nSaving to {OUTPUT_FILE}...")
    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(data, f)

    # Print summary
    total_neurons = sum(len(s['unit_regions']) for s in all_sessions)
    total_trials = sum(s['n_trials'] for s in all_sessions)
    print(f"Total sessions: {len(all_sessions)}")
    print(f"Total neurons: {total_neurons}")
    print(f"Total trials: {total_trials}")
    print(f"Brain regions: {all_brain_regions}")
    print("Done!")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""
Convert NWB data from the MAP (Mesoscale Activity Project) dataset into the
standardized decoder format.

Data source: "Brain-wide neural activity underlying memory-guided movement"
Processing follows: "Brain-wide analysis reveals movement encoding structured
across and within brain areas"

Key decisions:
- Neuron filtering: Only "good" units (classifier-based QC per the data paper)
- Session filtering: >65% correct on control trials, >=50 correct lick-left
  and >=50 correct lick-right trials (per the data paper methods)
- Trial filtering: Exclude auto_water and free_water trials (not real behavioral
  trials). Keep early lick and no-response (ignore) trials since early_lick and
  outcome are decoder outputs.
- Brain region: Use anno_name (CCF annotation) mapped to major categories;
  fall back to electrode group target region for units without annotation.
- Temporal alignment: Go cue onset, [-2.5, 1.5] s, 50 ms bins (80 bins)
- Firing rates: spike counts per bin / bin_width
- Tone onset: last sample_start before each trial's go cue (the successful
  presentation, not earlier replays from early licking)
- Photostimulation: binary time series, 1 during photostim on period
- Tongue y-position: discretized per session using DLC confidence > 0.9 for
  visibility, percentiles over visible positions in the entire session
"""

import os
import glob
import json
import pickle
import numpy as np
import h5py
from collections import OrderedDict

# ---- Parameters ----
TIME_BEFORE = 2.5    # seconds before go cue
TIME_AFTER = 1.5     # seconds after go cue
BIN_SIZE = 0.05      # 50 ms bins
N_BINS = int((TIME_BEFORE + TIME_AFTER) / BIN_SIZE)  # 80
BIN_EDGES = np.linspace(-TIME_BEFORE, TIME_AFTER, N_BINS + 1)
BIN_CENTERS = (BIN_EDGES[:-1] + BIN_EDGES[1:]) / 2

MIN_PERFORMANCE = 0.65
MIN_CORRECT_PER_SIDE = 50

DLC_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.9

DATA_DIR = '/app/data'
OUTPUT_FILE = '/app/converted_data.pkl'

# ---- Brain region mapping ----
# Maps anno_name base (before comma) to major region categories
# following the reference code's 14 regions
ANNO_TO_REGION = {
    # ALM = anterior lateral motor cortex = secondary motor area
    'Secondary motor area': 'ALM',
    # Other cortex
    'Primary motor area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Primary somatosensory area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Primary visual area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Agranular insular area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Anterior cingulate area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Retrosplenial area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Prelimbic area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Dorsal peduncular area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Frontal pole': 'OtherCortex',
    'Infralimbic area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Supplemental somatosensory area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Visceral area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Gustatory areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Temporal association areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Perirhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Ectorhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Entorhinal area': 'OtherCortex',
    'Posterior parietal association areas': 'OtherCortex',
    'Postsubiculum': 'OtherCortex',
    # Orbital
    'Orbital area': 'Orbital',
    # Striatum
    'Caudoputamen': 'Striatum',
    'Striatum': 'Striatum',
    'Nucleus accumbens': 'Striatum',
    'Fundus of striatum': 'Striatum',
    # Pallidum
    'Pallidum': 'Pallidum',
    'Globus pallidus': 'Pallidum',
    'Substantia innominata': 'Pallidum',
    'Bed nuclei of the stria terminalis': 'Pallidum',
    # Thalamus
    'Thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anteromedial nucleus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anteroventral nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Central lateral nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Lateral dorsal nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Lateral posterior nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Mediodorsal nucleus of thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Paracentral nucleus': 'Thalamus',
    'Posterior complex of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Reticular nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Submedial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral anterior-lateral complex of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral medial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral posterolateral nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Ventral posteromedial nucleus of the thalamus': 'Thalamus',
    'Anterodorsal nucleus': 'Thalamus',
